WildSpark 2.2.55 adds a separate, resizable WildMaps dungeon atlas while retaining the existing minimap lens.

- Browse bundled full maps and floors for supported dungeons.
- Zoom with the mouse wheel, pan by dragging, and resize or move the atlas window.
- Show approximate boss locations and client-provided player coordinates when available; the game does not provide reliable indoor coordinates for every dungeon.
- Shift-click the map to save a personal marker on a floor.
- Include source attribution and license notices with the bundled map tiles.
- Stop WildBuffs from scanning nearby players in rested and sanctuary city areas.

The package is validated locally. Dungeon positioning and window behavior have not been tested in the live game client.
